column1: # boru Language Specification: `as` — call-site signature selection (dispatch ascription)
# Format: input<TAB>expected<TAB>description
# `v as T` returns v UNCHANGED, carrying a match-time ascription: the
# NEXT signature match treats v as a T, then arg delivery strips it —
# the value a handler / fn body receives is the real one. Upcast-only
# (T must be an ancestor of v's tag). This is the delegation escape for
# anchored override bodies (design/OPEN-WORDS.1.md §9): inside a
# subtype's `set` override, `set k v (m as FlexMap)` dispatches the
# BASE overload — the override's nominal anchor cannot match the
# widened view — with no renamed shadow words and no retagging.
# §1  the value is unchanged — ascription is dispatch-only
typeof (5 as Number)
column3: typeof sees the REAL tag: ascription never retags

column1: (5 as Number) is Integer
column3: is sees the real value too

column1: (5 as Number) add 1
column3: the handler receives the real payload through the widened match

column1: (5 as Number) eq 5
column3: equality is over the real value

column1: (5 as Integer)
column3: self-ascription is a benign no-op; the value renders as itself

column1: size ('abc' as String)

column1: # §2  user newtypes — widen to the base family, keep the tag
def S (refine FlexMap)  def w:S (flex {a:1})  typeof (w as FlexMap)
column3: the newtype tag survives the ascription (typeof consumes the real value)

column1: def S (refine FlexMap)  def w:S (flex {a:1})  (w as FlexMap) is S
column3: the widened view is match-time only — the value is still an S

column1: def S (refine FlexMap)  def w:S (flex {a:1})  typeof ((w as FlexMap) as Node)
column3: re-ascription replaces the previous ascription (last one wins); the tag still survives

column3: the list column ascribes identically

column3: an in-place write through the widened view mutates the SAME payload; the binding keeps its tag

column1: # §3  signature selection — the core: the ascribed type picks the overload
def S (refine FlexMap)  def tag fn [[m:FlexMap] [String] ['base']]  def tag fn [[m:S] [String] ['sub']]  def w:S (flex {a:1})  tag w
column3: specificity picks the subtype overload for a subtype value

column1: def S (refine FlexMap)  def tag fn [[m:FlexMap] [String] ['base']]  def tag fn [[m:S] [String] ['sub']]  def w:S (flex {a:1})  tag (w as FlexMap)
column3: the ascription forces the base overload — the S sig cannot match the widened view

column1: def S (refine FlexMap)  def tag fn [[m:FlexMap] [String] ['base']]  def tag fn [[m:S] [String] ['sub']]  def w:S (flex {a:1})  [(tag (w as FlexMap)) (tag w)]
column3: one call widened, the next dispatches naturally — the ascription was consumed

column1: # §4  one-call consumption — the ascription never leaks into storage
def S (refine FlexMap)  def w:S (flex {a:1})  def y (w as FlexMap)  typeof y
column3: def binds the REAL value: the ascription is consumed at arg delivery

column1: def S (refine FlexMap)  def tag fn [[m:FlexMap] [String] ['base']]  def tag fn [[m:S] [String] ['sub']]  def w:S (flex {a:1})  def y (w as FlexMap)  tag y
column3: a binding made from an ascribed value dispatches on its real tag

column1: def S (refine FlexMap)  def w:S (flex {a:1})  def lst [(w as FlexMap)]  typeof (lst get 0)
column3: a list element stores the real value — no ascription smuggled into containers

column1: def S (refine FlexMap)  def w:S (flex {a:1})  def m2 {v:(w as FlexMap)}  typeof (m2 get v/q)
column3: a map value stores the real value too

column1: def S (refine FlexMap)  def w:S (flex {a:1})  def f fn [[x:Map] [Type] [typeof x]]  f (w as FlexMap)
column3: a fn param binds the real value: the body sees the subtype tag

column1: # §5  the delegation headline — an anchored core-word override delegates
#     through as, in core vocabulary, with no renamed shadow words and no
#     self-recursion. (The FULL sorted-map acceptance — the per-key resort
#     loop — runs interpreted in lang/go/test/sorted_user_test.go: its
#     dynamic get-result key feeding the now-multi-overload `set` is
#     outside today's compiled dispatch-commit boundary, the same residual
#     documented in design/OPEN-WORDS.1.md §9.)

def SortedFlexMap (refine FlexMap)  def set fn [[k:Atom/q v:Any m:SortedFlexMap] [SortedFlexMap] [(set (k) v (m as FlexMap)) drop  m]]  def w:SortedFlexMap (flex { })  (set b/q 2 w) drop  [(keys w) (typeof w)]
column3: an anchored set override delegates to the base overload via as — the body says set, not a renamed shadow

column1: def SortedFlexMap (refine FlexMap)  def set fn [[k:Atom/q v:Any m:SortedFlexMap] [SortedFlexMap] [(set (k) v (m as FlexMap)) drop  m]]  def w:SortedFlexMap (flex { })  (set b/q 2 w) drop  (set a/q 1 w) drop  [(keys w) w.a (typeof w)]
column3: repeated writes through the override terminate — the as-delegation can never re-enter the override

column1: def SortedFlexMap (refine FlexMap)  def wr fn [[k2:Atom v2:Any m2:SortedFlexMap] [SortedFlexMap] [(set (k2) v2 (m2 as FlexMap)) drop  m2]]  def set fn [[k:Atom/q v:Any m:SortedFlexMap] [SortedFlexMap] [(wr (k) v m) drop  m]]  def w:SortedFlexMap (flex { })  (set b/q 2 w) drop  [(keys w) (typeof w)]
column3: the override can route through a helper fn that itself delegates via as

def S (refine FlexMap)  def m (flex {a:1})  (m as S)
column3: downcast declined: as widens dispatch, it never claims a subtype

column3: cross-family ascription declined: String is not an ancestor of Integer
the target operand must be a type

column1: # §7  gradual — a dynamic value ascribes optimistically, validated at run time
def m (flex {a:1})  def d (m get (convert String 'a'))  ((d as Number) add 1)
column3: a dynamic read the lattice cannot refute passes the check gradually; the runtime validation proves it and dispatch commits at the ascribed type

column1: def m (flex {a:1})  def d (m get (convert String 'a'))  (d as Map)
column3: the runtime validation catches a dynamic value that does not conform to the ascribed type

column1: # §8  the fn-return boundary — an ascription never rides out of a call
# A fn/lambda/module call is an abstraction boundary: the value it hands
# back is its REAL self, so an ascription written in the body cannot leak
# into the caller's dispatch (design/OPEN-WORDS.1.md §9). Everything else
# is INLINE value-routing and stays transparent — a paren group, an
# if-branch, and a code-body word (do/each/fold) all route the value to
# the next dispatch, which consumes the ascription there (matching the
# compiled path, where `as` folds into the static dispatch selection).
def S (refine FlexMap)  def tag fn [[m:FlexMap] [String] ['base']]  def tag fn [[m:S] [String] ['sub']]  def w:S (flex {a:1})  def helper fn [[] [S] [(w as FlexMap)]]  tag (helper)
column3: a helper returning an ascribed value hands back the REAL S — the caller's tag dispatches on the subtype, not the leaked ascription

column1: def S (refine FlexMap)  def w:S (flex {a:1})  def helper fn [[] [S] [(w as FlexMap)]]  typeof (helper)
column3: the returned value is unchanged (the ascription was dispatch-only and is consumed at the fn-return boundary)

column1: def S (refine FlexMap)  def tag fn [[m:FlexMap] [String] ['base']]  def tag fn [[m:S] [String] ['sub']]  def w:S (flex {a:1})  def h1 fn [[] [S] [(w as FlexMap)]]  def h2 fn [[] [S] [(h1)]]  tag (h2)
column3: the strip holds through a chain of returns — no frame lets the ascription escape

column1: def S (refine FlexMap)  def tag fn [[m:FlexMap] [String] ['base']]  def tag fn [[m:S] [String] ['sub']]  def w:S (flex {a:1})  tag (if true [(w as FlexMap)] [w])
column3: an if-branch is INLINE value-routing — the ascription flows to tag and is consumed there (transparent, not a fn boundary)

column1: def S (refine FlexMap)  def tag fn [[m:FlexMap] [String] ['base']]  def tag fn [[m:S] [String] ['sub']]  def w:S (flex {a:1})  tag (do [(w as FlexMap)])
column3: a code-body `do` is inline too — its result routes the ascription onward (transparent, matching the compiled fold), unlike a fn return
